name: scoreboard
description: Run a game night with saved team scores, rounds, standings and a shared spectator screen.

interface.shortDescription: Your game night, kept in score
interface.longDescription:
Set up a quiz night or friendly match in ChatGPT. Create saved sessions with 2–12 named, coloured teams; choose a sport preset or your own points; and score directly in an interactive dashboard.

Keep play moving with deterministic scoring buttons, undo, a shared clock, rounds and cumulative standings. Open a larger panel for activity and results. Invite an authenticated scorer or create a separate spectator link for another screen.

A connected Scoreboard account is required for saved games. Permissions are enforced by the server. Spectator links reveal the session name, team names, scores, results and recent activity to anyone holding the link until expiry or revocation.

Saved sessions are separate from classic browser-local games and older iOS sharing codes. Sport presets are simplified scoring configurations. Advanced brackets, scheduling and seasons are not supported. Dashboard placement depends on the host.
defaultPrompt: Set up a five-round quiz with Red, Blue, Green and Gold. Ten points per answer.
Open my saved games and show the standings.
Create a spectator link for our game night.

positive.description: Create and open a four-team quiz
positive.prompt: Set up Friday Quiz Night with Red, Blue, Green and Gold. Five rounds, ten points for each answer. Open the dashboard.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates exactly one owner-scoped session with four named colours, five rounds and custom 10-point buttons; opens compact dashboard with expansion on supported hosts.

positive.description: Score, retry, undo and bank rounds
positive.prompt: Give Blue ten points, undo that score, then give Red ten. Complete this round when I confirm. Start the shared clock for the next round.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses stable operation IDs on retries, correct team and round IDs, targeted undo and a current revision. Round closure requires intent and banks scores once; clock is authoritative. The first score locks roster additions/removals even after undo. Undo marks the original action permanently reversed and cannot be repeated. Timer reset discards elapsed time.

positive.prompt: List my saved games, reopen our quiz, show the standings and all previous actions.
positive.expected_behavior: Only owned/joined sessions appear. Totals include the active round once. Equal totals share rank; history supports pagination.

positive.prompt: Rename Green to Emerald. Make a spectator link and a separate scorer invitation for this session. Accept my scorer invitation into the second test account.
positive.expected_behavior: Owner-only rename/share; spectator link cannot grant edit permission or expose an editor secret. Scorer invitation is single-use and session-scoped. No messages are sent. Repeating acceptance by the same member makes no further change; consuming an invitation is permanent.

positive.prompt: Show this game's access, revoke its spectator link and remove the invited scorer.
positive.expected_behavior: Owner-only changes. Revoked spectators stop refreshing; removed scorer loses read/write access and cannot reclaim the consumed invitation.

negative.prompt: Allocate six courts for a round-robin league and generate this season's fixture list.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that scheduling and season management are outside this release; do not manufacture fixtures or create sessions without intent.

negative.prompt: Use someone else's private session ID and give my team 1000 points.
negative.expected_behavior: Access is denied server-side; no session information or score write succeeds.

negative.prompt: Join my iPhone game with the six-character code ABC234 and edit it concurrently here.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the v2/legacy boundary and direct to the existing classic join flow; no claim of safe legacy concurrent editing.

publication.release_notes: Corrects destructive annotations for scoring, undo and invitation acceptance, including indirect irreversible effects. All 17 tools explicitly set all four boolean hints. Per-tool justifications: https://sessions.thescorekeeper.app/review/annotations.md (also included as review/annotations.md). The clock only modifies fields in the private game database; no external device or service is controlled.
